about.heroBody: We are a social network for paid questions and answers. Here you can ask public, private and anonymous questions to the people you are interested in, whether you are looking for advice, an exchange of knowledge and experiences, or are simply curious.
about.step1Body: Create your account and set up your PIX key, your privacy settings and your public profile.
about.step2Body: Ask questions by paying the amount you think is fair for the answer you expect to get.
about.step3Body: Answer questions and get paid for your answers.
about.step4Body: Like the answers that brought you value, report problematic questions and answers, and help us improve our community.
about.paymentsBody: Questions can be paid by PIX (BRL) or with credits bought by card via Stripe (USD). Questions paid with credits are paid out to the recipient's Stripe account once answered, with the same platform fee. If a question paid with credits is declined, expires or is reported, the person who asked gets all the credits back.
about.ctaBody: Join our community and start sharing your knowledge, experiences and curiosity with people who want to hear what you have to say.

terms.metaDescription: Read the terms of use of the Askedly platform
terms.acceptanceBody: By accessing and using the Askedly platform (https://respondeae.com.br), you agree to these Terms of Use.
terms.serviceBody: Askedly is a platform where users can ask other people paid questions and receive answers. Questions must cost at least {min}, paid by PIX, and the suggested amounts are {v2}, {v5}, {v10}, {v20}, {v50} or any other whole amount chosen by the user. When a question is answered properly, the author of the answer receives the amount paid for the question, minus the fees described in section 4 - Payments.
terms.limitsBody: Each user can ask up to 10 public questions and 1 anonymous question per day. This limit exists to prevent abuse and spam and to keep the platform a healthy environment. As the use of the platform evolves over time, these limits may be raised or lowered if necessary.
terms.paymentsBody: A fee is charged on every question asked so that we can maintain and improve the platform's services. The fee depends on the price of the question:
terms.paymentsFeeLow: 50% when the question costs {v5} or less.
terms.paymentsFeeHigh: 30% when the question costs more than {v5}.
terms.paymentsExample1: Example 1: João paid {v5} to ask Ana a question. The fee on this amount is 50%, that is, {half5}. If Ana answers the question properly, she receives {half5}.
terms.paymentsExample2: Example 2: Pedro paid {v10} to ask Maria a question. The fee on this amount is 30%, that is, {fee10}. If Maria answers the question properly, she receives {net10}.
terms.methodsBody: Questions can be paid by PIX, in Brazilian reais (BRL), or with credits bought by card through Stripe, in US dollars (USD). When a question paid with credits is answered, the amount is paid out to the recipient's Stripe account, with the same platform fee described in section 4. If a question paid with credits is declined, expires or is reported, the full amount of credits is returned to the person who asked it. The withdrawal and refund rules in section 10 apply to questions paid by PIX.
terms.privacyBody: Users can configure their profile to show or hide their answers publicly, show or hide the likes and dislikes on their answers, ask private questions and restrict their profile to followers only, among other preferences that help protect their privacy.
terms.validityBody: Each question sent has its own validity period of 7 calendar days to be answered. After that period, the question is considered expired and can no longer be answered. The amount paid for the question is automatically returned to the payer's account.
terms.conductTitle: 8. Rules of Conduct and Prohibited Content
terms.conductBody: You may not post or send content that is illegal, offensive, defamatory or obscene, that infringes copyright, or that constitutes spam or harassment. Users are responsible for all the content they post and for using the platform appropriately. We reserve the right to remove any inappropriate or offensive question or answer and to ban users who break these rules.
terms.reportsBody: Every question and answer can be reported, both by the person who received the question and by the person who received the answer. After a considerable number of reports in a day, week or month, the author of the question or answer may be penalized.
terms.reportsPenalty1: 1st offense: account access blocked for 30 days
terms.reportsPenalty2: 2nd offense: account access blocked for 180 days
terms.reportsPenalty3: 3rd offense: permanent deletion of the account
terms.withdrawalsBody: Withdrawals: withdrawal payments are processed exclusively via PIX and sent to the PIX key configured in your account. You need a balance of at least {minWithdraw} to request a withdrawal on the platform.
terms.refundsBody: Refunds: when a question you paid for is declined or expires, the amount is added to your account balance, and you can also withdraw it once the balance reaches {minWithdraw}. This money cannot be used to ask new questions at this time, because each paid question is tied to a specific PIX payment.
terms.liabilityBody: Askedly is not liable for direct, indirect, incidental or consequential damages related to the use of the platform. The questions and answers posted by users are the sole responsibility of whoever posts them. We count on the community's cooperation to keep the environment healthy and productive.
terms.inactiveBody: Accounts that go more than 730 consecutive days (2 years) without being accessed (the user did not sign in to their account during that period) are considered inactive and deleted from the platform. Two warning emails are sent, the first 7 days before and the second 48 hours before the possible deletion of the account, so that the user is aware.
terms.changesBody: These terms may be changed at any time. We recommend that users review this page periodically. Changes take effect immediately after publication.
terms.contactBody: If you have questions, suggestions or problems related to these Terms of Use, contact our team through the <link>contact form</link>.

privacy.metaDescription: Read the Privacy Policy of the Askedly platform
privacy.collectBody: We collect only the data that is essential for the platform to work. This includes your name, email and nickname and, when you sign in with Google, the URL of your profile avatar. We also store the PIX key you enter in your settings, which is used exclusively to receive payments. In addition, we collect the information you voluntarily add to your public profile, such as your description, website and social networks (Instagram, Facebook, YouTube, Twitch, LinkedIn, TikTok).
privacy.useBody: We use your information to provide and improve our services, personalize your experience, communicate with you about your account and publicly display only the data you chose to make visible on your profile.
privacy.sharingBody: We do not sell, rent or share your personal information with third parties, except when necessary to comply with legal obligations.
privacy.sharingTools: We use tools such as Google Analytics and Microsoft Clarity to understand how users behave on the platform, including browsing and interaction metrics. This data is used to continuously improve the platform experience, security and marketing strategies. More information about how Microsoft collects and uses your data can be found in the <link>Microsoft Privacy Statement</link>.
privacy.securityBody: We adopt appropriate technical and organizational measures to protect your personal data against unauthorized access, alteration, disclosure or destruction.
privacy.rightsBody: Under the LGPD (Brazil's General Data Protection Law), you have the right to access, correct or delete your personal data. You can also choose which information is displayed publicly on your profile. You can delete your account at any time. If the account is not reactivated within 30 days of deactivation, all data related to it is permanently removed from the platform.
privacy.contactBody: If you have questions or requests, or want to exercise your privacy rights, contact our team through the <link>contact form</link>.

contact.title: Contact
contact.intro: Have a question? Found a problem? Send us a message and we will get back to you as soon as possible.
